# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go." – Joshua 1:9
## Reflection
Men, the alarm goes off and the battle begins. Before your feet hit the floor, the enemy is already whispering that you don't have what it takes—that today will be too much, that you're too tired, too weak, too far gone. Joshua heard the same lies on the edge of the Promised Land. But God didn't coddle him; He commanded him. Strength and courage aren't feelings you wait for—they're orders you obey. Notice the foundation: "the Lord your God is with you wherever you go." You don't fight for victory; you fight from it. Your courage isn't rooted in your own grit but in the God who never leaves the field. So rise. Not because you feel strong, but because you've been commanded to stand—and because the One who commands you stands with you. A man who knows God is with him has no reason to run from the day. Face it head-on, and let your courage preach the gospel to everyone watching.
## Daily Challenge
Before your first task today, do 20 pushups and on each rep say, "God is with me." Then step into the day like a man on a mission.
